item.title: Headscale
item.description: Headscale is the open source, self-hosted implementation of Tailscale’s control node. It lets users take advantage of the tailscale client - available on all platforms - and create a mesh network. One of the major advantages of using headscale (and tailscale) is the subnet router and exit node feature. The subnet routing grants access to machines on the same subnet as the connected client. The exit node feature allows us to route traffic through a given node like a traditional VPN. Overall it’s one of the best self-hosting technologies, and the clear choice for remote access to the hackerspace network.
